editorial_notice: Curated source pointers, not an assertion of having downloaded or analyzed experimental mass spectra. Public dataset registration and sample-level experimental validation are distinct.

sources.title: GNPS - Charting the Cannabis plant chemical space with computational metabolomics
sources.description: Cannabis leaf and flower LC-MS/MS from Amnesia Haze and Royal Dutch Cheese samples; deposited at MassIVE. The deposit is marked Partial Public and CC0 1.0.
sources.publication_title: Charting the Cannabis plant chemical space with computational metabolomics
sources.sample_scope: Cannabis leaf and flower extracts; named varieties include Amnesia Haze and Royal Dutch Cheese.
restrictions: Dataset registration does not authenticate user-selected MGF files or their labels.
A GNPS networking task is not an independently verified reference-standard cannabinoid identification.
Exact sample-level control, blank, replication and experimental polarity must be checked from the accompanying metadata.
Some dataset files may be inaccessible because the deposit is marked Partial Public.
No spectrum files have been ingested into the Cannabiverse repository as part of this source registry.
